newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting finance results.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down, awaiting finance results.

text.p: Thai stocks were seen falling on Tuesday as investors wait for half-year financial results of finance companies which are beginning to trickle in, brokers said.

"I think the index will move sideways down today as investors wait for earnings results of finance companies which have begun to be announced through the market. There may be some buying later in the day," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.
The SET Index closed 2.91 points lower at 653.37 on 5.66 billion baht turnover on Friday. The market was closed on Monday for a Buddhist holiday. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
